master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production complete vehicle master for Bogmaster 2. Reference 1 approved Swamp Scout defines premium semi-realistic painted game illustration, readable dark contours, weathered surfaces and fine mechanical detail. Reference 2 Swamp Ox defines ONLY perpendicular camera and realistic close rear tandem layout, NOT tanker load. Reference 3 is exact matching road tire/rim design. Draw a chrome silver conventional short-bonnet all-terrain 6x6 cargo truck carrying a folded water-drilling rig securely strapped horizontally inside a low canvas-sided cargo bed with exposed bows so folded drill mast, hoses and drilling machinery are visible. Thick dried mud. Exactly THREE visible near-side road wheels: close rear tandem underneath heavy drilling machinery at left, one front steer wheel beneath cab at right. Identical 1.35 m chunky mud-terrain tires matching wheel reference, centered circular silver rims. Total vehicle 8.1 metres, exactly SIX tire diameters bumper-to-bumper, absolutely below 16.8 m. Intended wide PNG 2048 x 1024, whole vehicle with clear margins four sides. Horizontal chassis, bed and folded drill mast; all hubs precisely horizontal, all tire bottoms on a level line. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Facing RIGHT, front grille face NOT visible and no visible bed end face. Real heavy-truck conventional cab with distinct short bonnet, radiator housing, blunt practical bumper, headlamp and round-clearance front fender, clean seams; no fused melted wedge panels. All road tires completely visible; steps do not obscure them. Small correctly scaled rectangular mirror near A-pillar on short rigid brackets, no long arms. Soft even daylight, true transparent background and internal gaps. No text logos watermarks ground drop shadow checkerboard halo glow or scenery.
master.visualReview: Strict right-facing side profile; level round tires; close tandem carries folded drilling rig; plausible distinct bonnet, blunt bumper, round front fender and short mirror mounts; clear margins and transparent internal gaps.
